The '''Credit Case Surprise''' was a custom weapon produced by [[Synnt-ovations, Inc.]] Disguised as a briefcase filled with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the device was mainly employed by wealthy businesspeople. When attackers would attempt to steal from the individual, the Credit Case Surprise could be activated, causing a large flash of light which would temporarily blind the attacker, giving the owner a chance to escape.
